subject: POC runway: flexible extension vs performance credit top-up
messages:
From: Ryan Cole <ryan@loomis.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha@loomis.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Loomis POC — short extension or token top-up?

Vivek —

Thanks again for the run so far. Our team has run two end-to-end flows and overall latency/throughput looks good, but we’re about to hit our time-box finish next Monday and engineering still needs a week to complete the final integration tests.

Quick ask: can Redwood either (A) extend the current time-box by 4 weeks at a discounted rate, or (B) provide a performance-credit top-up (tokens/compute) that would let us complete validation inside the same window?

What matters to us: predictability for finance (so a small, one-off AMOUNT is easier) and a committed SLA for the last week while we do customer-facing load testing. We’re open to either approach if the economics align.

Also can you confirm you have our usage summary attached? I’ve included the CSV from our monitoring.

Would appreciate a short proposal today — we’re trying to lock internal approvals on Tue.

—Ryan
Ryan Cole
Head of Platform
Loomis Analytics

Attachment: loomis_usage_summary_Q2.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ryan Cole <ryan@loomis.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Loomis POC — short extension or token top-up?

Ryan — thanks for the clear ask and the usage file. We can support both paths; below are two pragmatic options and the trade-offs so you can present them to finance/engineering: 

Option 1 — Time-box extension (4 weeks)
- Extension fee: 15% discount off the standard short-trial rate (one-off invoice).
- Includes: continued dedicated capacity profile for the same instance size, 1x business-hourly priority during the extension, and audit logs export at the end.
- SLA: 99.5% uptime for the extension window; business-hour on-call for the final week.
- Good if you want straight-forward accounting.

Option 2 — Performance-credit top-up
- One-off credit equal to ~200k tokens (based on your burn rate from the CSV) plus a 10% credit bonus.
- Includes: immediate throttling bump for load testing and a single warm-standby deployment for the final week.
- SLA: best-effort on warm-standby; we guarantee capacity reservation for the final 72 hours.
- Good if you want to keep to the current time-box but need compute headroom.

Quick note on price: Option 1 will be slightly higher in cash terms but cleaner for procurement. Option 2 keeps the accounting within the existing POC balance. If it helps, we can do Option 1 with a reduced SLA commitment (99% uptime) for a further 5% discount.

I’ve attached a draft SOW for the extension (Lo omis_SOW_v1.pdf). If you confirm which option, I’ll loop in contracts and send a DocuSign-ready amendment.

We can also jump on a 15-min call this afternoon to run the numbers with your finance contact.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Loomis_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Loomis POC — short extension or token top-up?

Per Vivek — leaning to Option 2 for faster close but we should offer a small concession on guaranteed final-week capacity (reserve last 72 hours) and a 5% early-sign credit if they pick Option 1 and sign the amendment today.

Numbers (back-of-envelope)
- Option 1 (4-week extension): net price = base_rate * 0.85 -> finance comfortable?
- Option 2 (200k token top-up + 10% bonus): counts against POC bucket; low friction for procurement.

If Kimberly is good, I’ll draft the amendment language: 4-week extension term, termination clause, and a single performance milestone for sign-off.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Kimberly responded with a one-liner: "5% early-sign incentive for Option 1 acceptable; agree Option 2 for speed."

From: Ryan Cole <ryan@loomis.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha@loomis.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Loomis POC — short extension or token top-up?

Vivek / Priyom / Kimberly —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Loomis will take Option 2 (performance-credit top-up) to keep procurement simple. Two asks before we proceed:
1) Please send a short amendment doc that records the credit amount and the 72-hour reserved capacity window (we don’t need a full contract amendment, just a single-page exhibit we can attach to the PO).
2) Confirm who will be on-call the final week and the contact information for escalation.

If you can send the exhibit + DocuSign link this afternoon, I’ll route to finance for a one-click approval.

Appreciate it — looking forward to closing this out.

—Ryan
Ryan Cole
Head of Platform
Loomis Analytics

Attachment: Loomis_PO_Draft.docx (referenced; not attached in thread)
